title: The Ctrl bar appears too slowly when Ctrl is held
body:
Holding Ctrl alone should show the per-pane bars after a short pause. Jack
reports on 2026-11-06 that the bar shows up far too slowly to feel like a
response to the key.

What the code does, in `src/compositor.rs`: a Control press inserts a
calloop `Timer` of `BAR_HOLD`, 300 ms; when it fires, `show_bar(true)` sets
`layout.bar` and calls `relayout`, which reconfigures every pane's client
and requests a redraw. The clients then re-render one row shorter, and the
chrome is diffed and patched on the next frame.

## Open

- Whether the 300 ms itself is the problem, or the time after it: the
  reconfigure round trip to every client plus the redraw. Measure with a
  timestamp at the timer firing and at the next frame submit before changing
  either.
- A shorter hold, around 150 ms, is the first thing to try if the timer is
  the cost. Showing the bars in the chrome at once and reconfiguring the
  clients after, so the bar appears over the client's top row for a frame,
  is the second.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/575e4e76
notes.text:
Timestamps on a debug build with two panes, in ms after the Ctrl press, over four presses:

| timer fired | bars submitted | last client commit |
|---|---|---|
| 300 | 300.8 | 325.6 |
| 300 | 300.7 | 324.9 |
| 300 | 300.7 | 325.9 |
| 300 | 300.6 | 327.0 |

The hold was the delay. The reconfigure round trip after it took about 26 ms, so the second idea in the body, drawing the bars before reconfiguring, was not worth doing. Jack tried 50 ms and kept it.
